incident.name: Cegedim Santé Healthcare Breach
incident.vector: Unauthorized access to healthcare SaaS platform
incident.description: 15.8M French patient records stolen from Cegedim's MonLogicielMedical platform used by 3,800 doctors. Included sensitive free-text notes with HIV status, psychiatric diagnoses, and sexual orientation. Breach occurred Oct 2025, disclosed March 2026 — 4 months later.
incident.root_cause: Delayed breach disclosure, insufficient access controls on healthcare SaaS
incident.lessons: Healthcare SaaS platforms holding sensitive clinical notes require the highest security standards. Breach disclosure delays harm patients.

relatedIncidents.name: Conficker Worm
relatedIncidents.description: Conficker infected 9-15 million Windows machines, creating one of the largest botnets ever. Exploited unpatched Windows RPC.
relatedIncidents.lessons: Automated patch management and network monitoring are essential.

relatedIncidents.name: Change Healthcare Ransomware
relatedIncidents.description: Largest healthcare data breach in US history. Disrupted prescription processing for weeks. $22M ransom paid.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: No MFA on Citrix remote access, single point of failure in healthcare infrastructure
relatedIncidents.lessons: Healthcare critical infrastructure requires MFA everywhere and resilient architecture.

relatedIncidents.name: PowerSchool Data Breach
relatedIncidents.description: Attackers used stolen credentials to access PowerSchool's student information system, exposing data of 62M+ students and teachers across thousands of school districts in the US and Canada.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: No MFA on maintenance portal, credentials stolen via infostealer malware
relatedIncidents.lessons: Education sector SIS platforms hold sensitive PII for millions of minors and require MFA and strict access controls.
